newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco to buy back up to 5 pct shares.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco to buy back up to 5 pct shares.

text.p: Tenneco Inc Monday said its board approved a new stock repurchase program that will allow the company to purchase up to five percent of its currently outstanding shares.
The repurchase could amount to 8.5 million shares, worth about $340 million at Friday's closing price.

"This action reflects our belief that Tenneco stock represents an excellent investment, based on the strong fundamentals of our automotive parts and packaging businesses," said Dana Mead, Tenneco chairman and CEO.
"This program is the company's second major stock buyback in two years and, combined with our very disciplined acquisition strategy, demonstrates our commitment to maximizing shareowner value."

In 1995 and 1996 Tenneco repurchased approximately $750 million of its stock. The company said it will begin purchases immediately. The rate of repurchase will depend upon market and business factors.
